question: National Rural Employment Guarantee Act was passed in which of the following years?
solution:
The correct answer is __**2005**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The National Rural Employment Guarantee Act (NREGA) was passed by the Indian Parliament in **2005**.
 
• The act aims to enhance the livelihood security of households in rural areas by providing at least **100 days of guaranteed wage employment** in a financial year to every household whose adult members volunteer to do unskilled manual work.
 
• The act was later renamed as the **Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Act (MGNREGA)** in 2009.
 
• **Dr. Manmohan Singh** was the Prime Minister of India when NREGA was enacted.
 
• The scheme is considered one of the largest and most ambitious social security and public works programs in the world.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Objective of NREGA:**

 
 
• The primary objective is to enhance livelihood security in rural areas by providing at least 100 days of wage employment in a financial year.
 
• Secondary objectives include creating durable assets, improving water security, soil conservation, and higher land productivity.
 
 
 
• **Implementation:**
 
 
• Implemented by the Ministry of Rural Development, Government of India.
 
• The scheme operates on a decentralized, participatory planning approach.
 
 
 
• **Funding:**
 
 
• The central government bears the cost of wages for unskilled labor, 75% of the cost of materials, and certain administrative costs.
 
 
 
• **Transparency and Accountability:**
 
 
• Use of IT and biometric systems for transparency.
 
• Social audits and the establishment of grievance redressal mechanisms to ensure accountability.
 
 
 
• **Impact:**
 
 
• Has significantly contributed to poverty reduction in rural areas.
 
• Empowered rural women by providing employment opportunities.
